sources.title: Orbi README
sources.locator: Intro; Quick start; What it does; License
sources.finding: GitHub Issue labelled ai-ready to Pi implementation in a worktree, PR, independent review, merge, release; GitHub Issues are the only state store (no database, queue or daemon); systemd/launchd timer ticks every 5 minutes; AGPL-3.0 or Sustainable Use License; Orbi Cloud offered.

sources.title: Workflow
sources.locator: The complete chain; Steering; Delivery labels; Epics, Release tasks and P0; blocked by; .github/orbi.toml
sources.finding: Seven delivery states via labels, bounded review/fix loop, steering by comment, epics via native sub-issues, release state machine, blocked-by queueing, repository policy file.

sources.title: Configuration reference
sources.locator: Scheduling; Model provider; Delivery behaviour; Steering; Notifications
sources.finding: max_concurrency 1-5, pi_provider/pi_model/pi_thinking, review_pi_* overrides, human_review_gate, steering keys, Telegram notifications; telegram token excluded from Pi environment.

sources.title: Security
sources.locator: Delivery boundaries; The AI never merges; Local state files; Repository-level config trust
sources.finding: Runner is the only merge actor, merges the reviewed head with --match-head-commit; no sandbox; secrets local; credential-routing keys host-only; no task DAG, multi-agent parallelism or policy engine.

sources.title: Operations
sources.locator: Timers; CLI; Public surface; Worktrees; Failure recovery; Concurrency; Logs
sources.finding: orbi CLI subcommands, journal events, slots as flock files, worktree retention, failure recovery and resume rules.

sources.title: Public contracts
sources.locator: Public interface inventory; comment kinds; clarification; draft command contract

sources.title: Getting started
sources.finding: Prerequisites Python 3.14, uv, Pi CLI on Node 22.19+, git, gh >= 2.94, systemd user session (Linux) or launchd (macOS, not verified on real hardware).

sources.title: Model providers
sources.locator: Catalog; Sign in with ChatGPT; Codex OAuth; free tiers
sources.finding: Providers via Pi: DeepSeek, xAI, OpenRouter, Gemini, z.ai, Cloudflare Workers AI, local llama.cpp, GitHub Models, ChatGPT/Codex OAuth, Groq, OpenCode; quota and billing stay with the provider.

sources.title: OpenCode provider
sources.locator: What is authenticated; Catalog and Orbi configuration
sources.finding: OpenCode Zen is used as a Pi model provider with an API key, not as a harness.

sources.title: Docker (community-maintained)
sources.locator: When to use it; Quick start; Boundaries
sources.finding: Community Linux container that runs the unmodified official deployment with systemd as PID 1; env vars ORBI_PI_*; Linux only; no compose.

sources.title: Sustainable Use License
sources.finding: Orbi is dual-licensed: AGPL-3.0 or the Sustainable Use License v1.0; self-hosting on own repositories free under either.

sources.title: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (LICENSE)
sources.finding: Repository root LICENSE is the verbatim AGPL-3.0 text.

sources.title: Claude plugin manifest
sources.finding: Plugin with /orbi:ship and /orbi:status commands and skills that write ai-ready Issues; it does not expose Orbi operations over MCP.

sources.title: Pi process launch
sources.locator: pi_process.py env filter at line 681 (drops ORBI_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN); the --no-extensions flag is set in src/orbi/pi_command.py line 65
sources.finding: Sessions start the Pi executable with provider/model/thinking flags and the Runner environment minus ORBI_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN; no container or sandbox wrapper.

sources.title: Review rounds
sources.finding: Review/fix loop capped at five rounds before ai-blocked.

sources.title: Claim scan
sources.finding: The claim scan skips an Issue while any native blockedBy blocker is open.

sources.title: Merge execution
sources.locator: merge method selection lines 94-121; gh pr merge
sources.finding: Runner merges with gh pr merge using the repository-allowed method and --match-head-commit.

sources.title: Prometheus exporter
sources.finding: Optional read-only exporter derives metrics from the systemd journal; labels exclude run ids and prompts.

sources.title: orbi status
sources.finding: orbi status reports slots, active deliveries and the next ready Issue; --follow streams.

sources.title: systemd timer template
sources.finding: Runner tick every five minutes, one timer instance per concurrency slot.

sources.title: Orbi Cloud billing
sources.finding: Free (3 merged deliveries), Solo (400M tokens/month, 1 repo), Pro (1.2B tokens/month, 5 repos); Stripe billing; no per-token overage; self-hosting stays free.

sources.title: Orbi Cloud limits and quotas
sources.locator: At a glance; The monthly token allowance; What is never interrupted
sources.finding: Token usage counts input, output and cache reads; quota pauses new claims only; BYOK resumes; running deliveries are never interrupted.

sources.title: Orbi Cloud security
sources.locator: Isolation between tenants; Where your model key lives; Branch protection
sources.finding: Per-tenant separate OS user environment; BYOK key AES-256-GCM at rest; repository access limited to the GitHub App installation; Orbi merges as the same App identity.

sources.title: Orbi Cloud model configuration
sources.locator: Supported providers; How your key is stored
sources.finding: Platform model channel by default, BYOK providers incl. OpenAI, DeepSeek, Anthropic compatibility, Gemini, OpenRouter, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

sources.title: Orbi Cloud status page
sources.locator: Task history; Usage and settings; On a phone; Refreshing
sources.finding: Browser status page with task history tabs, per-task elapsed time and token usage, project overview, usage, phone layout, 15-second observation.

sources.title: Orbi Cloud notifications
sources.finding: Telegram messages for blocked, needs-detail, awaiting-merge and merged; not a live stream; replying does not steer.

sources.title: Orbi Cloud provisioning
sources.finding: Per-repository dedicated environment is created, cloned and set up in 10-20 seconds.

sources.title: Orbi Cloud FAQ
sources.finding: No install needed; GitHub App on private repos and organizations; dependent Issues via blocked by; steering up to 3 restarts; merge without approval unless branch protection requires one.

sources.title: Orbi website pricing data
sources.finding: Website repository pricing data: Solo US$29/month (US$290/year), Pro US$79/month (US$790/year), 3 free merged deliveries, 400M and 1.2B token allowances.

sources.title: Orbi Cloud privacy policy
sources.finding: Cloud sends prompts and repository context to the default model (DeepSeek deepseek-flash) unless a customer key is configured; Stripe processes payments; deletion by request.

sources.title: GitHub repository API for orbi-build/orbi
sources.finding: Repository has 255 stars, GitHub-detected licence AGPL-3.0, default branch main, last push 2026-11-16.

sources.title: Orbi releases
sources.finding: v0.7.45 published 2026-11-16 is the latest release at retrieval; releases are tags with notes and no binary assets; v0.7.40 to v0.7.45 shipped in eight days.

sources.title: Bounded search: desktop/mobile/web clients
sources.locator: rg -i "electron|tauri|react.native|webview|flask|fastapi|uvicorn" src tools systemd launchd; windows|win32
sources.finding: No desktop app, mobile app, editor extension or web UI in the engine repo; matches only a test ratchet tool and the optional metrics exporter HTTP server; Windows only appears in Pi idle handling comments. Orbi Cloud has its own browser status page documented separately.

sources.title: Bounded search: API, MCP server, webhooks, SDK
sources.finding: No webhook receiver, MCP server, HTTP API or SDK in the engine; the only MCP mention is a note about the pi-mcp-adapter Pi package; automation surface is the orbi CLI, GitHub labels and comments.

sources.title: Bounded search: telemetry
sources.locator: rg -i "telemetry|posthog|sentry|analytics|mixpanel|segment" src docs 3rd systemd templates prompts integrations
sources.finding: No telemetry or analytics code or documentation in the engine repo; outbound calls are GitHub (gh), the model endpoint, Telegram when configured, and the engine source update channel.

sources.title: Bounded search: roles, SSO, presence
sources.finding: No SSO, roles, presence or multi-user session features; authorization relies on GitHub repository permission (admin/write) for trusted comments and steering.

sources.title: Bounded search: cost tracking
sources.finding: No per-task cost, spend limit or budget code; matches are unrelated text. Orbi Cloud reports tokens per task in its status page (documented).

sources.title: Bounded search: container or sandbox for agent
sources.finding: The engine spawns Pi directly on the host as the Runner user in a git worktree; no per-task container, VM or OS sandbox. Docker is only a community wrapper around the whole runner.

sources.title: Bounded search: other coding agent harnesses
sources.locator: rg -i "claude code|codex cli|opencode|gemini cli|cursor agent|aider" src prompts
sources.finding: No adapter for another coding agent CLI; only Pi is launched (pi_executable must accept Pi flags). Codex and ChatGPT are reachable as model providers through Pi.

sources.title: Bounded search: indexing, multimodal, memory, rollback
sources.finding: No repository indexing or embedding feature, no screenshot/recording capture, no cross-task memory store and no task revert command in the engine; matches are unrelated (CI triage text, KV-cache note, engine install rollback).

sources.title: Bounded search: schedules and event triggers
sources.finding: Only the five-minute timer tick; no cron-style task scheduler or event trigger besides labels polled on each tick (Orbi Cloud wakes the runner when ai-ready is added, per its FAQ).
